messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — after the strict fncall schema gate rollout we pushed last night, we're seeing ~2% of traffic routed to the degen path and those are showing up as full tool executions in billing. Anyone else noticing quota spikes?

sam: yup, spotted a small spike in eu-west around 02:10 UTC. dashboard shows a pile of rejects with reason 'unexpected_array' and sample_rate is 1.0 for those events.

alex: Can you paste one of the failing payloads? want to confirm if it's a union vs array mismatch or our validator choking on streaming fragments.

maria: here's a redacted example from the logs:

```json
{"user_id":"acct_123","fncall":{"name":"attach_files","args":{"items":[{"name":"a.pdf"}]}} ,"validation_error":"expected object for 'attachments' but got array"}
```

sam: looks like callers sometimes send items instead of attachments object. previous soft-validate accepted it and we coerced, strict gate rejects and routes to degen which triggers tool adapter.

trish: two quick options: 1) temporary shim in the gateway to coerce items->attachments when schema mismatch but tag the metric, or 2) rollback strict gate for this fn until we ship a clearer migrate/compat layer. lean 1 for minimal user impact.

ryan: we need telemetry changes either way. Current metrics lump 'degen' into generic tool_executions so billing/ops can't tell strict-gate rejects apart. Propose new tags: route=degen, reject_reason=strict_schema, fncall_coercion=true/false. That will let console show per-route billing and we can make a short-lived billing-exemption for these.

maria: agreed on telemetry tagging. trish — can you spike the shim? alex — can you add the new tags in the router and the metric pipeline? ops-bot if we deploy shim, we want a short TTL flag.

ops-bot: deploying shim candidate to canary (eu-west) now with flag shim.coerce_attachments=true, TTL=4h. rolling back automatically if error_rate > 1%.

ingest-bot: alert created — INC-11843: fncall-strict-gate-degen-spike. linked to thread.

alex: router change ready locally. metric names: fncall.route, fncall.reject_reason, fncall.coerced. I'll open a tiny PR that adds these tags to the meter in router/service layer. needs review from @ryan.

ryan: will review. once tags are in, we can update console to break down per-route token costs. pls keep sample_rate for rejects at 100% until we confirm attribution is correct.

trish: shim pushed to canary. quick note — it coerces only if payload matches one of known legacy shapes and adds header X-Fncall-Coerced: true. no full tool invocation if coercion not needed.

sam: can confirm canary is handling the mismatches and billing spike in eu-west flattened out. will monitor for next 2 hours.

maria: awesome. next steps: (1) alex PR for tags (2) trish confirm full rollout plan and TTL (3) ryan update console breakdown + temporary billing exemption ticket to finance. I'll own consolidating postmortem and a docs blurb for SDK devs.

ryan: tagging the console card as 'priority' for this cycle. finance pinged.

maria: thanks all — please drop any follow-ups in INC-11843 thread. :thumbsup:
